where_you_are: Sir Phidipaldi is with Quinn in the empty Golden Egg Tavern. Wayman and Dr. Uriah are across the street in the Clumsy Fox Tavern. Dunk is at Farmer Gill's farm on the edge of town, staying the night in the barn.

immediate_intention.text: Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn are about to stage a fake ale shipment. Quinn will bring bottles and they will fill them with water. Then Sir Phidipaldi will make a big show of delivering them to see what happens. Quinn offered 100 gold for the help.
